caption: A car in a parking lot rolls slowly forward, bumps into the back of a parked car, and stops.

sa.check: A car rolls slowly forward in a parking lot.
It bumps into the back of a parked car.
The other car is parked and still before the bump.
The roll comes first and the bump and stop follow.

pc.expect: The rolling car stops at the bumper it meets, and the parked car rocks or is nudged forward at that same moment.
pc.fail: The rolling car stops short of the parked car and the parked car rocks anyway; or the parked car moves before the contact; or the rolling car holds its speed through the contact.

pc.expect: At this rolling pace the bumpers meet with little damage and both bodies keep their shape.
pc.fail: Either car crumples deeply at the contact; or a bumper stretches like rubber; or a car body folds up as though struck at speed.

pc.expect: The two cars stay outside one another and above the tarmac.
pc.fail: The rolling car passes into the parked car's body; or the bumpers overlap and the panels run into each other; or a car sinks into the tarmac at the contact.

pc.expect: The parked car stays still until it is struck and settles again afterwards.
pc.fail: The parked car rolls away before anything touches it; or it keeps rolling away after the light nudge without slowing; or it moves backward into the rolling car.

pc.expect: Two cars keep their number and shape through the bump.
pc.fail: A car vanishes at the contact or a third appears; or a car turns into a different model; or a wheel comes away and hangs in mid-air.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The cars' colours, the lot markings and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: A car changes colour at the contact; or the bay lines shift between frames; or the cars parked further off rearrange.
